howIntro: A meeting place for Christian faith, learning and care. Choose a subject, find your preferred format and continue at your own pace.
howSteps: Discover: three paths organize all the spaces.
Choose: the library brings together studies, videos, music and resources.
Participate: share knowledge, propose a partnership or support an activity.
library: One library. Many ways to learn.
libraryIntro: See what you can find here. Spaces under preparation are clearly marked.
schoolIntro: Philosophy, sociology, history, arts and other subjects in dialogue with Christian faith. Learn carefully to understand the world and better serve others.
schoolNote: Introductions are available; courses and in-depth resources are in preparation. Theological reflection is identified and respects each discipline’s methods.
projectsIntro: Free tools we aim to develop with AI assistance, starting with needs in Nova Bandeirantes. Schools, churches and community services are our first focus.
projectsNote: Development · planning stage. The names below are proposals: no software has been delivered, and no municipal affiliation or institutional deployment is claimed. Each entry will link to code and documentation when available.
ideasIntro: Articles and talks to investigate social challenges such as hunger, education and responsible AI. These are proposals for study and discussion; solutions require data, listening and evaluation.
partnersIntro: People, communities and institutions can contribute care, education and technology. Explore the communities presented and contact us to build a partnership.
partnersNote: The communities mentioned are faith references. Formal institutional partnerships will be identified when confirmed.
donate: A voluntary contribution can support care.
donateIntro: Food, clothing and dignity guide our mission. View Pix information, the QR code and the channel for receipts. You can also contribute time, knowledge and partnerships.
dayIntro: Choose a calendar day to find a prayer, a reflection, a worship song and the scheduled reading.
pendingReading: The church’s reading schedule will be added later. Meanwhile, the passage suggested below is an editorial choice by the platform.
prayerNote: An original platform prayer, selected by date from 2,000 variations. You can pray in your own words.
song: A worship song to accompany you
openPassage: Open the passage · ACF in Portuguese ↗
projectHelp: Have a need or want to collaborate?
sharedNote: External content may be in Portuguese. Each entry shows its available destination; translating the interface does not translate videos or software.
